EmailTemplate.name: Health & Welfare External Email Template
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for contacting Insperity’s Section 125 Team
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for your email. Your request will be handled in the order it was received. You can expect a response within 48 hours. If you are responding to a request from our team, the Specialist assigned to your case will reach out to you.
If you would like to speak to someone by phone, please contact the Insperity Contact Center at 866-715-3552, or via secure live chat on your Insperity Portal. Insperity Contact Center Specialists are available weekdays from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM CST.
Thank you,
Section 125, Health & Welfare Services
